meta.name: safe-debug
meta.description: Rigor Debug / Rigor Audit skill for deep learning research work. Use when the user pastes a traceback, terminal error, CUDA OOM, checkpoint load failure, shape mismatch, NaN loss symptom, or training failure and wants conservative diagnosis before any patching, with debug fixes clearly separated from research contributions. Do not use for broad refactoring, speculative adaptation, automatic exploratory patching, or general repository familiarization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把训练报错粘进来,先给出稳妥的成因判断,再给出与实验改动分开的修复方案。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果训练跑着跑着就报错或崩掉,却不想乱改代码。
copy.tagline_en: Paste training errors, get conservative root-cause diagnosis before patching
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your training run crashes and you want a careful fix that leaves research code alone

howto.what: 装上后,当你贴出报错或训练失败症状时,它先做保守诊断、缩小根因范围,默认不改仓库代码;需要修补时先给最小补丁方案并要求你明确同意,产出 DIAGNOSIS.md、PATCH_PLAN.md、status.json 三份文件。
howto.when: 当你贴出 traceback、CUDA OOM、checkpoint 加载失败等具体训练失败症状,并希望先诊断再动代码时触发。不用于大规模重构、推测性改造或通读仓库。

say.text: 这是我训练时的报错,先帮我定位根因,别改代码
say.note: 会产出 DIAGNOSIS.md 诊断文档

say.text: 按诊断给最小补丁方案,改之前等我确认
这个修复会影响实验可比性吗?
say.note: 会说明调试修复与科研贡献的区别

howto.what_en: Diagnoses first: paste an error or failure and it narrows the root cause without editing repo code. For fixes it proposes the smallest patch and waits for approval, writing DIAGNOSIS.md, PATCH_PLAN.md, status.json.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you paste a traceback, CUDA OOM, checkpoint load failure or similar training failure and want diagnosis before patching. Not for broad refactoring or speculative adaptation.

say_en.text: Here's my training error - find the root cause first, don't change code
Give me the smallest patch plan and wait for my approval
Does this fix change experiment comparability?
say_en.note: Flags debug fix vs research contribution
